maddeler.e:
انسطلت (form VII)
# اِنْسَطَلْتُ (insaṭaltu) /in.sa.tˤal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# اِنْسَطَلْتَ (insaṭalta) /in.sa.tˤal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# اِنْسَطَلْتِ (insaṭalti) /in.sa.tˤal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# اِنْسَطَلَتْ (insaṭalat) /in.sa.tˤa.lat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
